questions.stem: Which of the following diseases is caused by a virus?
questions.solution: Measles is caused by a virus. Typhoid is caused by bacteria, Asthma is a respiratory condition, and Diabetes is a metabolic disorder.

questions.stem: Which of the following diseases can be prevented by vaccination?
questions.solution: Measles can be prevented by vaccination. Typhoid can be prevented by proper hygiene, Asthma is a chronic condition, and Diabetes is a metabolic disorder.

questions.stem: What is the natural ability of the body to fight diseases called?
questions.solution: Immunity is the natural ability of the body to fight diseases, as it refers to the body's defense mechanisms against harmful pathogens. Infection is the process of a pathogen entering the body and causing illness, vaccination is a method to stimulate immunity, and recovery is the process of getting better after an illness.

hi.stem: शरीर के रोगों के विरुद्ध लड़ने की प्राकृतिक क्षमता क्या कहलाती है?
hi.solution: प्रतिरोधक क्षमता शरीर की रोगों के विरुद्ध लड़ने की प्राकृतिक क्षमता है, क्योंकि यह शरीर के रक्षा तंत्र को संदर्भित करता है। संक्रमण एक पैथोजन के शरीर में प्रवेश करने और बीमारी पैदा करने की प्रक्रिया है, टीकाकरण प्रतिरोधक क्षमता को उत्तेजित करने के तरीके के रूप में है, और उबरना बीमारी के बाद ठीक होने की प्रक्रिया है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, terminology, and structure. All options and the solution are correctly translated and maintain the same logical relationships.

mr.stem: शरीराच्या आजारांचा लढा देण्याची प्राकृतिक क्षमतेला काय म्हणतात?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a common method of transmission of communicable diseases?
choices: By sharing a book with an infected person
By breathing in air from an infected person
questions.solution: Breathing in air from an infected person allows pathogens to enter the respiratory system, making it a direct method of disease transmission. Eating raw vegetables, sharing a book, or touching a clean surface do not provide a viable route for most communicable diseases to spread.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a non-communicable disease?
questions.solution: Diabetes is a non-communicable disease because it is not caused by infectious agents and does not spread between people. Common cold, tuberculosis, and cholera are all caused by pathogens and can be transmitted from person to person.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक गैर-संचारी रोग है?
hi.solution: मधुमेह एक गैर-संचारी रोग है क्योंकि यह संक्रामक कारकों द्वारा नहीं होता है और लोगों के बीच फैल नहीं सकता है। सामान्य जुकाम, टीबी और हैजा सभी पैथोजेन्स द्वारा होते हैं और लोगों के बीच संचारित हो सकते हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, technical terms are appropriately used in Hindi.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणता एक गैर-संसर्गजन्य आजार आहे?

questions.stem: A doctor prescribes antibiotics to a patient suffering from a bacterial infection. After taking the medicine, the patient feels better and stops taking the antibiotics. What could be the consequence of this action?
choices: The infection is completely cured and no further treatment is needed
The bacteria may become resistant to the antibiotic
The patient's immune system becomes stronger
The patient will develop a new infection
questions.solution: Stopping antibiotics early can allow some bacteria to survive and become resistant. This makes future infections harder to treat. The other options are incorrect because the infection may not be fully cured, the immune system is not directly strengthened by stopping antibiotics, and there is no evidence of a new infection being caused.

questions.stem: If a student is suffering from the flu and still comes to school, what should the school do to prevent the spread of the disease?
choices: Allow the student to sit in the class
Isolate the student and provide a mask
Encourage other students to sit near the infected student
questions.solution: Isolating the student and providing a mask helps prevent the spread of the flu. Allowing the student to sit in the class or encouraging others to sit near them can spread the infection. Ignoring the situation is not responsible.

questions.stem: What is the best way to prevent diseases spread through contaminated food and water?
choices: Drinking tap water and eating raw vegetables
Drinking boiled water and eating raw vegetables
Eating uncooked food and drinking tap water
Drinking boiled water and eating properly cooked food
questions.solution: Drinking boiled water and eating properly cooked food is correct because boiling water kills harmful pathogens, and cooking food destroys bacteria and parasites that can cause illness. The other options involve unsafe practices like drinking tap water, which may contain contaminants, and eating raw vegetables or uncooked food, which can carry harmful germs.

questions.stem: A farmer notices that some of his cattle are getting sick despite being given antibiotics regularly. What could be the most likely reason for this?

questions.stem: If a person is suffering from a disease that spreads through contaminated water, which of the following is most important to avoid the spread of the disease?
questions.solution: Maintaining personal hygiene is most important because it directly reduces the risk of transmitting diseases through contaminated water by preventing the spread of pathogens. questions.stem: Why is it important for the body to have a stronger immune response on second exposure to a pathogen?

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains the reason why some people get sick more frequently than others, even when living in a similar environment?
choices: They have a weaker immune system
They are more exposed to pollutants
They have a higher intake of unhealthy foods
questions.solution: The correct answer is that they have a weaker immune system. A weaker immune system is less effective at defending the body against pathogens, making a person more likely to get sick. The other options, such as exposure to pollutants, unhealthy food, or physical activity, do not directly relate to the body's ability to fight off illness as clearly as the strength of the immune system does.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन इस बात का सबसे अच्छा स्पष्टीकरण है कि क्यों कुछ लोग अन्य लोगों की तुलना में अधिक बार बीमार हो जाते हैं, भले ही वे एक ही पर्यावरण में रहते हों?
choices: उनका प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली कमजोर होता है
उनके अधिक प्रदूषकों के संपर्क में रहता है
उनका अस्वास्थ्यकर भोजन के अधिक सेवन करता है
उनके अधिक शारीरिक गतिविधि में रहता है
hi.solution: सही उत्तर यह है कि उनका प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली कमजोर होता है। कमजोर प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली शरीर के रोगजनकों के खिलाफ रक्षा करने में कम प्रभावी होता है, जिससे व्यक्ति बीमार होने की संभावना अधिक हो जाती है। अन्य विकल्प, जैसे प्रदूषकों के संपर्क में रहना, अस्वास्थ्यकर भोजन का अधिक सेवन या शारीरिक गतिविधि, प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली के बल के रूप में रोग से लड़ने की क्षमता के सीधे संबंध में इतना स्पष्ट नहीं होता है।

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते वाक्य एकसारख्या वातावरणात राहूनही काही लोक इतरांपेक्षा जास्त आजारी पडतात याचे सर्वात चांगले स्पष्टीकरण सांगते?
choices: त्यांचा रोग प्रतिकार प्रणाली कमजोर असतो
mr.solution: योग्य उत्तर त्यांचा रोग प्रतिकार प्रणाली कमजोर असतो. कमजोर रोग प्रतिकार प्रणाली शरीराला रोगजनकांविरुद्ध रक्षण करण्यास अक्षम करते, ज्यामुळे एखाद्या व्यक्तीला आजारी पडण्याची शक्यता अधिक असते. प्रदूषकांच्या प्रती, अस्वस्थ खाद्यपदार्थांच्या खासगी किंवा शारीरिक गतिविधी यांच्यासारख्या इतर विषयांचा शरीराच्या आजार विरुद्ध लढाईसोबत जास्त संबंध नसतो जेवढा रोग प्रतिकार प्रणालीच्या शक्तीचा असतो.
